THE CIVIC RECORD01 / Brief
The questionUrban heat & transit
The story in one sentence

A short wait can feel much longer without shade.

Where it happens

At exposed curbside stops, surface temperatures climb before the peak of the day. The design of a waiting area can matter as much as the length of the route.

What we examined

A demonstration comparison of four stop types, combining illustrative observations, assumed dwell times and a simple exposure index.

What the evidence cannot say

This sample does not measure health outcomes or represent a citywide survey. It shows how an evidence-led narrative can make limits visible.

Illustrative example, not a field study02 / 08
